7.1.4 Log messages from DEM
[SWS_Dlt_00377] ⌈The ApplicationID, ContextId and Message ID of a Log Message
sent for a DEM event shall have the following values:
ApplicationID = "DEM"
ContextId = "STD0"
MessageID = 0x00000001⌋
